title: JAISP: Joint AI Survey Processing. Rubin-Euclid foundation model, detection and astrometry heads, and catalogs
description: Code, trained weights, detection lists, per-band positions, and cross-survey concordance-field maps accompanying Hemmati et al. (2026), 'JAISP: A Joint Rubin-Euclid Foundation Model for Cross-Instrument Source Detection and Astrometry'. The foundation model is a masked-band autoencoder trained on ten-band Rubin DP1 and Euclid Q1 imaging of the ECDFS field; frozen features drive a source-detection head and a VIS-anchored astrometry head. See release/README.md for a description of every file. Code: BSD 3-Clause. Weights, catalogs and maps: CC BY 4.0.
